info.title: NeoRune - C# mods for Minecraft Dungeons II
info.description: The neorune command line for NeoRune, the C# modding SDK for Minecraft Dungeons II: read your mod's log (neorune log), see the bytecode your C# compiled to (neorune disasm), install built mods, and, for SDK maintainers, dump the running game's API and diff it after game updates.

options.name: --mod
options.description:
[--install] [--game <game folder>] [--tools <dir with retoc/repak>]
[--title <name>] [--version <x.y>] [--author <name>] [--author-url <url>]
[--description <text>]   (the Mods tab of Blueprint Loader 2.0)
[--bindings <NeoRune.Game.json>]  (warns NR0003 if the game is another build)
